correctness.rationale: For d>=3 on disjoint relative open facets, the orthogonal projection resets the selected largest positive barycentric coordinate to zero and adds lambda_j/d to all others; all target coordinates are positive. Relative rank rotates through d+1 labels; ties persist until a maximal tie then fix. The strict sorted gap recurrence is a primitive row-stochastic d-by-d companion matrix with first row 1/d, making uniform gaps the unique normalized attracting Perron fixed point and all nonunit modes contractive. Summing barycentric coordinates fixes gaps to 2/[d(d+1)], giving exactly d! primitive (d+1)-cycles and equal area basins 1/d! by facet symmetry. Independent exact-rational cycle and rank checks on d=3..6 corroborate, do not replace the proof.
residual_risks: Statement is only for regular simplices, relative open facets, and tie-to-fixed convention; no classification of other polytopes.
